confront.speaker: Stray Corusdeer
confront.text: A shape lifts its head from the tall grass, antlers catching the light — oaken-brown fading to a glow at the tips, cherry-red and warm enough to see the air shimmer above them. It watches you. One ear turns back toward the herd, then returns to you, and stays.

options._comment: #330 R1 banks tended_beasts here; corusdeer_calmed keeps banking as shipped. R3: the vouched twin below swaps in once the healed deer rejoins the herd.
options.text: [Basic Command] Steady it. Slow words, open hands.

options._comment: #330 R3 payoff: no Skill gate. An accomplishment requires is progress-gated, so this row is HIDDEN until the deer is healed.
options.text: Steady it. The herd knows your hands now.
